# LENK.TR

> LENK.TR is a Turkish and English service for managing short links, publishing bio pages, and viewing click statistics.

The public website is https://lenk.tr. Product pages and account interfaces are available in Turkish and English.

## Public pages
- [Home](https://lenk.tr/): Product overview, features, workflow, and bio page themes.
- [Pricing](https://lenk.tr/pricing): Plans and pricing information.
- [About](https://lenk.tr/about): About LENK.TR.
- [Contact](https://lenk.tr/contact): Contact form.
- [Security](https://lenk.tr/security): Security information.
- [Terms](https://lenk.tr/terms): Terms of service.
- [Privacy](https://lenk.tr/privacy): Privacy policy.

Use the public pages as the source of truth. Do not infer unpublished account data, link destinations, or analytics.
